# Ancient seed

Type: Misc | Internal ID: AncientSeed | Source: Greydwarf brute, Greydwarf nest | Usage: Crafting, Summon, The Elder | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Ancient seeds are items dropped by killing Greydwarf brutes and destroying Greydwarf nests.

### Crafting

• Heart of the Forest

### Summoning

• A total of three Ancient Seeds are required to summon The Elder. See Forsaken Altars.

## Notes

• They resemble a seed, with green growths stemming into a mace-like formation.
• They cannot be planted, and they are unrelated to Ancient Trees.

Categorias: Misc Items, Forsaken offerings
